lessons.title: Practice Enterprise Application Architecture
lessons.description: Checkpoint: export interface ApiResponse<T> { data: T; status: number; } and implement the generic function wrapData<T>(data: T): ApiResponse<T> returning { data, status: 200 }. Tests wrap both a number and an object and check status plus data for each. The test checks that num.status equals = 200 || num.data !== 5; res.status equals = 200 || !res.data.ok; num.status equals 200 || num.data !== 5.

lessons.title: Practice Readonly Fields in Classes
lessons.description: Class fields may be prefixed with the readonly modifier, which prevents assignments to the field outside of the constructor. Export a class Server with readonly port: number initialized in the constructor and a method portAddress(): string returning http://localhost:${this.port}. Tests construct Server(8080) and check both the field and the address. The test checks that s.port equals = 8080; s.portAddress() equals = 'http://localhost:8080'; s.port equals 8080.
learning_objectives: This step reads the readonly item stored by the constructor, using Bag holding flint.

source.name: TypeScript Handbook — Classes — readonly modifier: 'prevents assignments to the field outside of the constructor'
